decision_contract.promotion: every second-holdout case must pass quantitative metrics, threshold sides, and strict family ordering

diagnosis_inherited: scalar modal RMS compression loses signed cross-mode coupling

dimensional_diagnosis.defect: the first frozen phase driver divided encounter-scaled response bias by carrier mode
dimensional_diagnosis.derivation: omega equals k rho, temporal phase error equals k T (rho minus 1), and spatial shift equals temporal phase error divided by k, giving T (rho minus 1)
dimensional_diagnosis.threshold_reconciliation: k0 times shift divided by encounters estimates carrier-scaled response bias and contains no inverse carrier factor

semidiscrete_model.contamination: the phase-resolved off-target response is retained through the projected generator rather than reduced to one unsigned RMS scalar
semidiscrete_model.evolution: the reduced enforced generator is advanced by the same classical RK4 stability polynomial and declared step count
semidiscrete_model.signed_bias: packet-weighted signed response bias accumulates as encounters times mean bias in spatial shift
semidiscrete_model.spread: signed modal bias variation accumulates across the packet band and distorts the waveform

truncation_contract: cosine-sine modes through carrier plus four divided by pi sigma, capped at N minus 3
